description:
## Goal

Give every current source submission and reserved runtime source one stable typed `SourceOwner`, with each immutable text/provenance instance represented by a distinct `SourceVersion`. Owner identity answers “which logical source is this?”; version identity answers “which exact text and locations produced this observation?”

This is a live identity cutover for ordinary, runtime, and prelude submissions plus macro-mediated publication on the existing path. Macro results retain mixed node provenance and their lexical publishing owner; they are not fictitious source versions. This ticket does not expose replacement.

## Model

- Source-publisher jobs are keyed by stable owner and read that owner's current immutable version.
- Immutable source-map entries identify exact text/provenance versions. Tokens and quoted-node spans retain their originating version, including mixed-origin macro results. Quoted roots retain their existing content ownership; they are not assigned fictitious single-file versions.
- Module, function, type, struct, protocol, and generated callable identities remain typed semantic identities. Filenames, spans, display labels, submission position, and raw/interned ID ordering are never ownership.
- Generated callable code/capture identity is distinct from diagnostic provenance. This cut exposes typed lexical/generated origin from the existing function authority and removes display-name parsing of raw owner IDs, while preserving existing occurrence discrimination. Location-independent executable/capture identity remains `fz-tfn.57`'s replacement law.
- Existing World stores remain authoritative. Add no source mirror, replacement history index, rollback state, reconciliation pass, or compatibility identity.

## TDD signal

Through the public production path, prove unique stable owners and immutable versions for unnamed/named code, runtime modules, and preludes. Nested declarations and item/function-body macro publications retain their lexical publishing owner; mixed quote/unquote nodes retain definition/caller versions independently and mint no fake source text. Retained diagnostics and quoted/source spans resolve through their exact version. Generated callable canonical labeling reads typed origin rather than parsing its display name, while distinct occurrences remain distinct.

Preserve current semantic/product allocations, work counts, answers, diagnostics, and canonical artifacts, excluding the explicit source-identity representation change. Reserve runtime ownership without materializing cold source. Incidental owner/version allocation order must not affect semantic answers or canonical artifacts; explicit source/prelude ordering retains its language meaning. No cold function is lowered and no product is warmed by this refactor.

## Strategy and deletion

Replace compiler `CodeId` with opaque `SourceOwner`; cut the existing immutable `source::Id` over to opaque `SourceVersion` instead of adding a version registry. `CodeMap` holds owner publication state pointing to the immutable source entry and shares text/name storage with `SourceMap` rather than retaining parallel columns. Migrate every live source job, fact, declaration provenance field, parse boundary, telemetry key, and consumer in one coherent cut. Use explicit absence for source-less synthetic/global state. Do not leave parallel identity paths or convert by raw integer.

The sole existing `submit_code` path returns `SourceOwner`; do not add a `submit_source` adapter or live replacement API in this ticket. Delete `CodeId::from_source`, source/code ordinal coincidence, duplicate CodeMap name/text storage, identity inference from filename/display text, and generated-owner recovery from `#lambda:...` strings. Preserve the current span occurrence key until `fz-tfn.57`. Update fact-engine, pipeline, source, macro, type, and telemetry documentation from the final code.

Focused identity tests, full library/fixture/CLI doors, deterministic dumps, formatting, check, and strict Clippy pass. Fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review precedes the one commit and close.
title: Give every source one stable owner and immutable version
